'''Tress Aressa''' was an illegal [[Cyborg/Legends|cyborg]] living on [[Cloud City/Legends|Cloud City]] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]]. [[Gender/Legends|She]] owned several other illegal cyborgs and [[Vessel (cyborg)|vessels]].
